name: dsh-unified-agent-memory
description: Unified agent memory for DeepSeek Harness — one shared Obsidian vault for every agent (dsh, Codex, Claude, Hermes). Ships the dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), a vault template, and a dsh plugin with six tools (memory_search / memory_show / memory_submit / memory_status / memory_preview / memory_setup).
